newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Seaunion says change in major shareholder.
newsitem.headline: Seaunion says change in major shareholder.

text.p: Oil exploration firm Seaunion Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its single largest shareholder New Concept Technologies International Ltd has agreed to sell 770.47 million shares, or 25.8 percent of Seaunion, to third party Georgia Technologies Ltd at HK$0.13 per share.
On completion of the purchase on October 28, Georgia Technologies Ltd will become the single largest shareholder of Seaunion, it said.
Georgia Technologies Ltd intends to seek represention on the board of directors but it does not intend to change the management or operations of the company, Seaunion said.
New Concept Technologies had become Seaunion's largest shareholder in May after it bought a total 770.47 million shares or 25.8 percent stake from the company's shareholders at HK$0.119 per share.
